Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8035); Sem (i.e. Shem), a patriarch:-- Sem.
BiblicalUsage: Sem is Shem, the son of Noah, named in the genealogy of Jesus. The line runs through Cainan and Arphaxad to Sem, and from Sem to Noe and Lamech, carrying the promise from the ark to Abraham.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Shem's place in the line is the promise kept: the blessing spoken over Shem runs all the way to Jesus.
